classification.illumination_detail: self-emissive direct-view fine-pitch LED video display (1.87mm pixel pitch); content-driven, not a backlit face

program_model.instance_model: one stainless-clad ceiling-display design built at several display footprints (2x3, 2x5, and a 6x4 exterior unit); interior units use an indoor LED module, the exterior unit an outdoor-rated module of the same pitch family

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A ceiling-suspended direct-view LED video display wrapped in a brushed #304 stainless steel surround. A fine-pitch (1.87mm) LED display sits in a 3in aluminum U-channel frame with a 1/4in airflow gap, clad in 22ga stainless with a #4 finish, hung from the structure on 2in stainless support tubes through an escutcheon plate. Built in several footprints, including an outdoor-rated exterior unit.
knowledge.rationale: Direct-view fine-pitch LED gives a bright, seamless, fully dynamic display for changing passenger information, and the minimal stainless surround with a concealed support-tube hang reads as architectural hardware rather than a sign box.
knowledge.tradeoffs: A direct-view LED display is the most flexible and legible dynamic medium but is far costlier than static signage, generates heat (hence the airflow gap), and needs data/power runs and structural ceiling attachment.
knowledge.when_to_use: High-traffic transit and terminal environments needing bright, fully dynamic information at a ceiling datum with an architectural finish.

structure.construction: NanoLumens P1.87HDS indoor direct-view LED display (P1.87OD outdoor module on the exterior unit), 1.87mm pixel pitch
3in x 3in x 1/8in aluminum U-channel frame with 1/4in gap for airflow; 1/4in aluminum spacers; aluminum clips screwed to spacers with #8 x 3/8in pan-head screws
22ga #304 stainless steel cladding with #4 finish; brake-formed stainless Z-clips soldered/bonded to cladding; corners brake-formed and bonded with structural adhesive and 3M VHB foam tape
2in x 2in x 1/4in #304 stainless support tubes with escutcheon plate and mounting bracket assembly; 1in dia holes for data/power cable; ceiling attachment method to be verified
structure.install_caution: ceiling attachment method TBD pending structural verification

materials_manifest.product: aluminum U-channel frame, spacers, and clips

utilities.data_power: 1in dia. penetrations for data/power cable through support tubes; circuiting not detailed on this set

rules_observations: Minimal stainless reveal keeps the display itself the single read; the surround is hardware, not message.
Consistent 2-1/2in stainless border and #4 finish hold family consistency across the size variants.
craft_observations: Soldered/bonded brake-formed Z-clips and VHB-plus-adhesive corners give a fastener-free, seamless stainless surround, the pro-vs-amateur tell on architectural metal.
A 1/4in airflow gap is designed in to manage LED heat without visible venting.
Concealed support-tube hang through an escutcheon plate reads as architectural mounting rather than a sign bracket.

aesthetic_notes.note: Reads as integrated terminal architecture: a floating dark display in a precise brushed-steel frame, appropriate to a premium airline environment.
